name: tldr
description:
The tldr client is set up for the **windows** platform, sourcing its page files from the repository at https://github.com/tldr-pages/tldr.git and keeping its own source code in the repository https://github.com/example/tldr-client. Automatic updates are enabled even when a requested page cannot be found (the *skipUpdateWhenPageNotFound* flag is **false**). The current visual style selected is the **solarized** theme.

In the **solarized** theme the command is called **tldr**, described as “Simplified and community‑driven man pages.” An example usage displays a summary of the **ls** command: `tldr ls` (example token: **ls**) with the accompanying note “Show summary of the ls command.” The alternative **dark** theme also uses the **tldr** command, but its main description reads “Dark theme for terminal.” Its example shows how to display help for the **git** command: `tldr git` (example token: **git**), described as “Display help for the git command.”

solarized.exampleDescription: Show summary of the ls command.

dark.exampleDescription: Display help for the git command.
